remarks: Modern Living Meets Historic Charm in Whittier!    Welcome to 12035 Turnleaf Avenue, located in the desirable Groves community of Whittier! This inviting 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom townhome combines modern comfort, convenience, and lifestyle. Enjoy a thoughtfully designed floor plan, an attached two-car garage, and a private patio perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Beyond your front door, discover resort-style community amenities, including a sparkling pool, fitness center, greenway trail, and a unique historic clubhouse that adds timeless character to this modern community. Whether you're enjoying a refreshing swim, staying active, or spending time with neighbors, there's something for every
